frequency_question: What proportion of prioritized executive principal nominations successfully complete the confirmation process to take office?
membership_rule: Includes formal nominations to cabinet or equivalent major agency head positions where the executive explicitly prioritizes installation; excludes routine or withdrawn low-priority placeholders.
window: Within the standard 4-year presidential term window.
coverage_note: 10 named high-profile confirmations; representative of prioritized executive nominations where will and capability align.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier sub-cabinet posts where executive will is frequently diffuse.
skeleton: 10 sampled high-priority cabinet-level and major agency confirmations from recent presidential administration starts
validity_reason: Base rate tied to the current executive administration's structural approach to staffing and legislative dynamics.
